title: Scam dressed as help
body:
This app pretends to care about your well-being, but behind the pretty interface is a shady billing system. After a free trial, they silently charge your card without clear consent, and no confirmation email ever arrives. When you reach out, support asks for a code from an email you never received — classic deflection tactic.

Refund requests are ignored or delayed, and you’re left chasing shadows. Judging by the number of similar complaints online, this is not a bug — it’s a business model. Reported to my bank as fraud.

Response: already have done that, with no success. Refund request limited to a 250 characters, come on?! lol :D U do NOT take this seriously at all, otherwise how can u explain other users experiences same as mine, dating years back? This is not a sincere mistake, this is a pattern! U r violating the very same people u claim to be helping.. u were called on, stop with the excuses and stay straight and better yourselves!
